facts.statement: The genus Dasosaurus contains only one species, Dasosaurus tocantinensis.
facts.quote: The genus contains a single species, Dasosaurus tocantinensis.

facts.statement: The holotype of Dasosaurus represents a medium-to-large sauropod approximately 20 meters long.
facts.quote: The Dasosaurus holotype belongs to a medium-to-large sauropod, approximately 20 m long.

facts.statement: Dasosaurus fossils were discovered by archaeologist Daniel Ribeiro da Silva in Davinópolis, Maranhão, Brazil.
facts.quote: The Dasosaurus fossil material, CPHNAM VT 1600, was discovered by Daniel Ribeiro da Silva, an archeologist, in outcrops of the Itapecuru Formation in Davinópolis, Maranhão, Brazil.

facts.statement: The discovery of Dasosaurus was announced in 2021 as a new titanosaur taxon.
facts.quote: The discovery was announced in 2021, at which point the remains were identified as belonging to a new titanosaur taxon.

facts.statement: The name Dasosaurus combines the Greek words for 'forest' and 'lizard', referencing the Amazon rainforest type locality.
facts.quote: The generic name, Dasosaurus, combines the Greek words dasos, meaning 'forest'—in reference to the type locality in Amazônia Legal, a division of Brazil that includes the majority of Amazon rainforest—and saurus, meaning 'lizard'.

facts.statement: The specific name tocantinensis honors the state of Tocantins, near the type locality.
facts.quote: The specific name, tocantinensis, is after Tocantins, a state near Maranhão, where the type locality is situated.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen includes limb bones, ribs, and at least ten disarticulated tail vertebrae.
facts.quote: The specimen consists of phalanges, ribs, an ulna, radius, tibia, fibula, femur, pubis, ischium, and at least ten disarticulated caudal vertebrae.

facts.statement: Dasosaurus lived during the Aptian stage, between 119.57 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (119.57 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Dasosaurus is classified as a sauropod belonging to the group Somphospondyli.
facts.quote: A sauropod belonging to the group Somphospondyli.

facts.statement: The parent group of Dasosaurus is Somphospondyli.
Dasosaurus belongs to the class Saurischia.
Dasosaurus has a morphology similar to the European titanosauriform Garumbatitan.
facts.quote: Its morphology is similar to the titanosauriform Garumbatitan, known from the Early Cretaceous of Spain.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest Dasosaurus exhibits European affinities, indicating potential biogeographic connections between Brazil and Europe in the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: A new titanosauriform with European affinities in the Early Cretaceous of Brazil

rejected.statement: Dasosaurus is an extinct genus of somphospondylan sauropod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous of Brazil.
rejected.quote: Dasosaurus is an extinct genus of somphospondylan sauropod dinosaur known from the Early Cretaceous (Aptian) Itapecuru Formation of Brazil.
